name: Solar street-lamp air quality node
description: Self-powered PM2.5/PM10 + NO2/O3 monitor that clamps to a street lamp post with stainless band clamps. A vertical south-facing (+x) 25 W panel sheds snow and suits low winter sun; a 77 Wh LiFePO4 battery and duty-cycled sensors (~0.25 W average) give a week of autonomy. Data via LoRaWAN.

assembly.action: Survey existing lamp column: confirm 140 mm diameter, sound galvanising, anchor nuts tight, service door locked
U-bolt mast to both standoffs; fit top cap and drain plug
Wrap stainless bands through standoffs around the post and tension worm drives to 15 N·m
Inspect populated controller PCB (MCU, MPPT inductor, filter capacitors) and conformal coat
Strap battery to base, clip controller and radio on DIN rail, wire through 5 A fuse
Fit glands, blanking plug, breather vent and N-type bulkhead
Seat gasket, close lid with four captive screws; apply ID label
Snap angled louvres into both sides of the sensor shield
Mount PM and gas sensors in louvred shield; PM inlet out the front with mesh
Stack radiation plates on spacer rods under shield; thread T/RH harness between plates
U-bolt enclosure and shield bracket to the mast
Clamp tilt rails to mast top; set plates to vertical (0 deg) and torque pivot bolts
Bolt framed panel to tilt plates facing south; plug PV lead into panel gland
Screw whip with swivel knuckle onto bulkhead, set vertical
